q: 三年___，这里还是一家小面馆，现在已经是大饭店了。
zh: 三年以前，这里还是一家小面馆，现在已经是大饭店了。
py: sān nián yǐ qián zhè lǐ hái shi yì jiā xiǎo miàn guǎn xiàn zài yǐ jīng shì dà fàn diàn le
en: Three years ago this was still a small noodle shop; now it is a big restaurant.
why: A length of time plus 以前 means 'ago'. 的时候 cannot follow a span like 三年.

q: 吃完饭___，我想去散步。
zh: 吃完饭以后，我想去散步。
py: chī wán fàn yǐ hòu wǒ xiǎng qù sàn bù
en: After eating I want to go for a walk.
why: 吃完饭 is a clause, and 'after a clause' is 以后. 后来 never follows a clause.

s: 关于我来说，这个办公室太小了。
s_py: guān yú wǒ lái shuō zhè ge bàn gōng shì tài xiǎo le
zh: 对于我来说，这个办公室太小了。
py: duì yú wǒ lái shuō zhè ge bàn gōng shì tài xiǎo le
en: For me, this office is too small.
why: 'As far as I'm concerned' is 对于…来说. 关于 only introduces a topic and never goes with 来说.

s: 我小的以前，住在爷爷家。
s_py: wǒ xiǎo de yǐ qián zhù zài yé ye jiā
zh: 我小的时候，住在爷爷家。
py: wǒ xiǎo de shí hou zhù zài yé ye jiā
en: When I was little I lived at grandpa's house.
why: 'When I was little' is 我小的时候. 以前 means 'before' and cannot replace 的时候.

s: 请你又说一遍，我没听清楚。
s_py: qǐng nǐ yòu shuō yí biàn wǒ méi tīng qīng chu
zh: 请你再说一遍，我没听清楚。
py: qǐng nǐ zài shuō yí biàn wǒ méi tīng qīng chu
en: Please say it once more; I didn't hear it clearly.
why: A request asks for something not yet done, so 再. 又 describes a repeat that has already happened.

s: 明年我搬到新家，后来我要买一张大桌子。
s_py: míng nián wǒ bān dào xīn jiā hòu lái wǒ yào mǎi yì zhāng dà zhuō zi
zh: 明年我搬到新家，然后我要买一张大桌子。
py: míng nián wǒ bān dào xīn jiā rán hòu wǒ yào mǎi yì zhāng dà zhuō zi
en: Next year I'll move into a new home, and then I'll buy a big table.
why: 后来 only tells a past story. The next step in a future plan is 然后.

q: 下班___，我们一起去吃饭吧。
zh: 下班以后，我们一起去吃饭吧。
py: xià bān yǐ hòu wǒ men yì qǐ qù chī fàn ba
en: Let's go and eat together after work.
why: 'After a clause' is clause + 以后. 后来 and 然后 never attach to the end of a clause like 下班.

s: 这个房子很合适我们一家人住。
s_py: zhè ge fáng zi hěn hé shì wǒ men yì jiā rén zhù
zh: 这个房子很适合我们一家人住。
py: zhè ge fáng zi hěn shì hé wǒ men yì jiā rén zhù
en: This house is just right for our family to live in.
why: 合适 is an adjective and cannot take an object. With 我们一家人 following, we need the verb 适合.

s: 我做饭的时，常常听音乐。
s_py: wǒ zuò fàn de shí cháng cháng tīng yīn yuè
zh: 我做饭的时候，常常听音乐。
py: wǒ zuò fàn de shí hou cháng cháng tīng yīn yuè
en: I often listen to music while I cook.
why: 'When' is 的时候 (or 时 without 的). The half form 的时 does not exist.

q: 你___明天几点开会吗？
zh: 你知道明天几点开会吗？
py: nǐ zhī dào míng tiān jǐ diǎn kāi huì ma
en: Do you know what time the meeting is tomorrow?
why: 知道 takes a fact or a question clause such as a time. 认识 is only for people, characters and roads.

q: 我先去银行取钱，___去超市买菜。
zh: 我先去银行取钱，然后去超市买菜。
py: wǒ xiān qù yín háng qǔ qián rán hòu qù chāo shì mǎi cài
en: I'll go to the bank to get some money first, and then go to the supermarket for food.
why: 先…然后 links two steps in a plan. 后来 is only for past stories, and 以后 does not link the next step after 先; it follows a clause or means 'in future'.

q: 小王在聚会上把我介绍给了新同事，现在我们___了。
zh: 小王在聚会上把我介绍给了新同事，现在我们认识了。
py: xiǎo wáng zài jù huì shàng bǎ wǒ jiè shào gěi le xīn tóng shì xiàn zài wǒ men rèn shi le
en: Xiao Wang introduced me to the new colleague at the party, so now we know each other.
why: After an introduction two people have met, which is 认识. 知道 would only mean knowing of someone, and 了解 means knowing in depth.

q: 他一个人在国外___了很多事，所以很成熟。
zh: 他一个人在国外经历了很多事，所以很成熟。
py: tā yí ge rén zài guó wài jīng lì le hěn duō shì suǒ yǐ hěn chéng shú
en: Living abroad on his own, he went through a lot, so he is very mature.
why: Here we need a verb 'go through', which is 经历. 经验 is only a noun and cannot take 了.

s: 老师讲得很懂，我们都听明白了。
s_py: lǎo shī jiǎng de hěn dǒng wǒ men dōu tīng míng bai le
zh: 老师讲得很清楚，我们都听明白了。
py: lǎo shī jiǎng de hěn qīng chu wǒ men dōu tīng míng bai le
en: The teacher explained it very clearly, and we all understood.
why: How well someone explains is 讲得很清楚. 懂 is what the listener does, so 讲得很懂 is wrong.

q: 我学会做饭___，常常给家人做菜。
zh: 我学会做饭以后，常常给家人做菜。
py: wǒ xué huì zuò fàn yǐ hòu cháng cháng gěi jiā rén zuò cài
en: After I learned to cook, I often made meals for my family.
why: 学会做饭 is a clause, and 'after a clause' is clause + 以后, past or future. 后来 stands alone at the start of a later part of a story and can never be attached to a clause.

q: 我们明天去___那家新的美术馆。
zh: 我们明天去参观那家新的美术馆。
py: wǒ men míng tiān qù cān guān nà jiā xīn de měi shù guǎn
en: We're going to visit that new art museum tomorrow.
why: 参观 is for a place you look round. 看望 is only for a person you go to see.

q: ___我每个星期都去游泳，对身体有好处。
zh: 以后我每个星期都去游泳，对身体有好处。
py: yǐ hòu wǒ měi ge xīng qī dōu qù yóu yǒng duì shēn tǐ yǒu hǎo chu
en: From now on I'll go swimming every week; it's good for my health.
why: A resolution for the future starts with 以后 ('from now on'). 后来 only looks back, and 然后 needs a step before it.

q: 吃了药以后，我___头还是很疼。
zh: 吃了药以后，我觉得头还是很疼。
py: chī le yào yǐ hòu wǒ jué de tóu hái shi hěn téng
en: Even after taking the medicine, my head still really hurts.
why: Feeling pain is a body sensation, so 觉得. 认为 is a formal judgement and never used for body feelings.

s: 他上个星期感冒了，这个星期再感冒了。
s_py: tā shàng ge xīng qī gǎn mào le zhè ge xīng qī zài gǎn mào le
zh: 他上个星期感冒了，这个星期又感冒了。
py: tā shàng ge xīng qī gǎn mào le zhè ge xīng qī yòu gǎn mào le
en: He caught a cold last week, and this week he has a cold again.
why: The second cold has already happened, so it needs 又. 再 is only for repeats still to come.

s: 下班后来，我们去看电影吧。
s_py: xià bān hòu lái wǒ men qù kàn diàn yǐng ba
zh: 下班以后，我们去看电影吧。
py: xià bān yǐ hòu wǒ men qù kàn diàn yǐng ba
en: Let's go and see a film after work.
why: 后来 cannot attach to a clause, and it only looks back at the past. 'After work' is 下班以后.

q: 我___你已经下班了，原来你还在办公室。
zh: 我以为你已经下班了，原来你还在办公室。
py: wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ yǐ jīng xià bān le yuán lái nǐ hái zài bàn gōng shì
en: I thought you had already left work, but you're still at the office.
why: 原来 shows the belief turned out false: 以为. 觉得 and 认为 would not be followed by a reversal.

q: 我在北京住了十年，对这座城市非常___。
zh: 我在北京住了十年，对这座城市非常了解。
py: wǒ zài běi jīng zhù le shí nián duì zhè zuò chéng shì fēi cháng liǎo jiě
en: I've lived in Beijing for ten years and know the city very well.
why: 非常 shows depth of knowledge, and only 了解 takes a degree word. 知道 and 认识 never do.

q: 我们打算去云南___，想多尝尝那儿的菜。
zh: 我们打算去云南旅游，想多尝尝那儿的菜。
py: wǒ men dǎ suàn qù yún nán lǚ yóu xiǎng duō cháng chang nà r de cài
en: We plan to travel to Yunnan and want to try lots of the food there.
why: The pattern is 去 + place + 旅游, with the place before the verb. 看望 needs a person you go to see as its object, and there is none here.

q: 邻居搬家的时候，我们给了他很多___。
zh: 邻居搬家的时候，我们给了他很多帮助。
py: lín jū bān jiā de shí hou wǒ men gěi le tā hěn duō bāng zhù
en: When our neighbour moved house, we gave him a lot of help.
why: After 给了他很多 we need a noun, and the noun 'help' is 帮助. 帮 is only a verb, so 很多帮 is wrong.

q: 昨天他迟到了，今天___迟到了。
zh: 昨天他迟到了，今天又迟到了。
py: zuó tiān tā chí dào le jīn tiān yòu chí dào le
en: He was late yesterday, and he was late again today.
why: Both lateness events have already happened, so a repeat takes 又. 再 is for a repeat still to come.

q: 吃完这碗面，我突然___肚子不太舒服。
zh: 吃完这碗面，我突然觉得肚子不太舒服。
py: chī wán zhè wǎn miàn wǒ tū rán jué de dù zi bú tài shū fu
en: After finishing this bowl of noodles, I suddenly felt that my stomach was not quite right.
why: A body feeling takes 觉得. 认为 is never used for sensations, and 以为 needs a reversal that this sentence does not have.

q: 这家公司的地址我不___，你问一下经理吧。
zh: 这家公司的地址我不清楚，你问一下经理吧。
py: zhè jiā gōng sī de dì zhǐ wǒ bù qīng chu nǐ wèn yí xià jīng lǐ ba
en: I'm not sure of this company's address; ask the manager.
why: 不清楚 means you are not sure about a fact. 不懂 would say you cannot make sense of an address.

q: ___我不喜欢听老歌，现在很喜欢。
zh: 以前我不喜欢听老歌，现在很喜欢。
py: yǐ qián wǒ bù xǐ huan tīng lǎo gē xiàn zài hěn xǐ huan
en: I didn't use to like old songs, but now I like them a lot.
why: 以前 at the start of a sentence means 'in the past'. 的时候 must follow a clause and cannot stand alone.

q: 老板，请___给我来一杯热茶。
zh: 老板，请再给我来一杯热茶。
py: lǎo bǎn qǐng zài gěi wǒ lái yì bēi rè chá
en: Boss, could I have another cup of hot tea?
why: A request is about something not yet done, so 再. 又 cannot go after 请.

s: 这个时间对大家都很合适。
s_py: zhè ge shí jiān duì dà jiā dōu hěn hé shì
zh: 这个时间对大家都很合适。
py: zhè ge shí jiān duì dà jiā dōu hěn hé shì
en: This time suits everyone.
why: 合适 is an adjective with no object, and the person comes in a 对 phrase before it, so this is correct.

q: 我每天回家都___这家书店，里面总是有很多人。
zh: 我每天回家都经过这家书店，里面总是有很多人。
py: wǒ měi tiān huí jiā dōu jīng guò zhè jiā shū diàn lǐ miàn zǒng shì yǒu hěn duō rén
en: I walk past this bookshop on my way home every day, and it's always full of people.
why: Going past a place on the way is 经过. 通过 means by means of, or passing a test.

q: 他___音乐很感兴趣，常常去听音乐会。
zh: 他对于音乐很感兴趣，常常去听音乐会。
py: tā duì yú yīn yuè hěn gǎn xìng qù cháng cháng qù tīng yīn yuè huì
en: He is very interested in music and often goes to concerts.
why: 感兴趣 takes the target of the interest with 对 or 对于. 关于 cannot follow a subject like this.

q: 我___这家饭馆今天不开门，没想到还开着。
zh: 我以为这家饭馆今天不开门，没想到还开着。
py: wǒ yǐ wéi zhè jiā fàn guǎn jīn tiān bù kāi mén méi xiǎng dào hái kāi zhe
en: I thought this restaurant was closed today, but it turns out to be open.
why: 没想到 shows the belief was wrong, which is exactly what 以为 marks. 认为 and 觉得 state a view the speaker still holds.

q: 做菜需要___，不能只看书。
zh: 做菜需要经验，不能只看书。
py: zuò cài xū yào jīng yàn bù néng zhǐ kàn shū
en: Cooking takes experience; you can't just read books.
why: Know-how gained by doing is 经验. 经历 is what happens to you, so 需要经历 would not give this meaning.

s: 我认为很累，想回家睡觉。
s_py: wǒ rèn wéi hěn lèi xiǎng huí jiā shuì jiào
zh: 我觉得很累，想回家睡觉。
py: wǒ jué de hěn lèi xiǎng huí jiā shuì jiào
en: I feel very tired and want to go home to sleep.
why: Tiredness is a body feeling, so 觉得. 认为 is a considered judgement and cannot describe how you feel.

s: 这条路经过一家很大的书店。
s_py: zhè tiáo lù jīng guò yì jiā hěn dà de shū diàn
zh: 这条路经过一家很大的书店。
py: zhè tiáo lù jīng guò yì jiā hěn dà de shū diàn
en: This road goes past a very big bookshop.
why: 经过 is the verb for passing a place on the way, so it is correct with a shop as object.

q: 他没___汉语考试，下个月还要再考。
zh: 他没通过汉语考试，下个月还要再考。
py: tā méi tōng guò hàn yǔ kǎo shì xià ge yuè hái yào zài kǎo
en: He didn't pass the Chinese exam and has to retake it next month.
why: Passing an exam is 通过. 没经过 would mean he never went through it, which does not fit retaking it.

s: 周末我想去参观生病的奶奶。
s_py: zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng qù cān guān shēng bìng de nǎi nai
zh: 周末我想去看望生病的奶奶。
py: zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng qù kàn wàng shēng bìng de nǎi nai
en: At the weekend I'd like to go and visit grandma, who is ill.
why: A person you go to see is 看望. 参观 is only for places, such as a museum or a factory.

q: 这首歌很___在晚上一个人听。
zh: 这首歌很适合在晚上一个人听。
py: zhè shǒu gē hěn shì hé zài wǎn shang yí ge rén tīng
en: This song is just right for listening to alone at night.
why: 适合 is a verb and takes a verb phrase as its object here. 合适 is an adjective and cannot take one.

q: 我正在做饭___，邻居来敲门了。
zh: 我正在做饭的时候，邻居来敲门了。
py: wǒ zhèng zài zuò fàn de shí hou lín jū lái qiāo mén le
en: My neighbour knocked on the door while I was cooking.
why: 正在 marks an action in progress, so 'while' is 的时候. 以前 means before it began and cannot go with 正在.

q: 今天太忙了，有问题的话，我们明天___谈吧。
zh: 今天太忙了，有问题的话，我们明天再谈吧。
py: jīn tiān tài máng le yǒu wèn tí de huà wǒ men míng tiān zài tán ba
en: I'm too busy today; if you have questions, let's talk about them tomorrow.
why: 明天 is in the future, so a plan to do it later is 再. 又 needs an event that has already happened.

s: 谢谢你们的帮，我们已经搬完家了。
s_py: xiè xie nǐ men de bāng wǒ men yǐ jīng bān wán jiā le
zh: 谢谢你们的帮助，我们已经搬完家了。
py: xiè xie nǐ men de bāng zhù wǒ men yǐ jīng bān wán jiā le
en: Thank you for your help; we've finished moving house.
why: After 的 the noun 'help' is 帮助. 帮 is only a verb and cannot be the thing you thank someone for.

q: 每次在咖啡馆听到这首歌___，我都会想起大学的朋友。
zh: 每次在咖啡馆听到这首歌的时候，我都会想起大学的朋友。
py: měi cì zài kā fēi guǎn tīng dào zhè shǒu gē de shí hou wǒ dōu huì xiǎng qǐ dà xué de péng you
en: Every time I hear this song in a café, I think of my university friends.
why: The memory comes at the moment of hearing, so 的时候. 听到这首歌以前 would be before hearing it, which makes no sense here.

q: 那次生病的___让他明白了健康的重要。
zh: 那次生病的经历让他明白了健康的重要。
py: nà cì shēng bìng de jīng lì ràng tā míng bai le jiàn kāng de zhòng yào
en: That experience of being ill made him understand how important health is.
why: What he went through is 经历. 经验 is know-how and does not combine with 生病的.

q: 我小___，常常听爷爷唱歌。
zh: 我小的时候，常常听爷爷唱歌。
py: wǒ xiǎo de shí hou cháng cháng tīng yé ye chàng gē
en: When I was little I often listened to grandpa sing.
why: 'When I was little' is 我小的时候. 以前 cannot follow 我小, because 以前 needs a whole event clause or stands alone.

q: 请把电话号码写___，我怕看错。
zh: 请把电话号码写清楚，我怕看错。
py: qǐng bǎ diàn huà hào mǎ xiě qīng chu wǒ pà kàn cuò
en: Please write the phone number clearly; I'm afraid of misreading it.
why: 写清楚 means to write so that it can be read clearly. 写懂 does not exist, because 懂 is what a reader does.

q: 我在那本旧书里___了一张电影票。
zh: 我在那本旧书里发现了一张电影票。
py: wǒ zài nà běn jiù shū lǐ fā xiàn le yì zhāng diàn yǐng piào
en: I found a cinema ticket in that old book.
why: Coming across something that was already there is 发现. 发明 is to invent something new.

q: 这个汉字我不___，你能教我吗？
zh: 这个汉字我不认识，你能教我吗？
py: zhè ge hàn zì wǒ bù rèn shi nǐ néng jiāo wǒ ma
en: I don't recognise this character; can you teach me?
why: To recognise a written character is 认识. 了解 means to know a subject in depth and does not fit a single character.

q: 这个房租对你___吗？
zh: 这个房租对你合适吗？
py: zhè ge fáng zū duì nǐ hé shì ma
en: Is this rent all right for you?
why: 对你 already marks the person, so we need the adjective 合适. 适合 is a verb that wants the person right after it.

s: 他常常帮我的忙，我很感谢他。
s_py: tā cháng cháng bāng wǒ de máng wǒ hěn gǎn xiè tā
zh: 他常常帮我的忙，我很感谢他。
py: tā cháng cháng bāng wǒ de máng wǒ hěn gǎn xiè tā
en: He often helps me out, and I'm very grateful to him.
why: 帮忙 is separable: the person goes between the two halves as 帮我的忙. This is the correct way to give it an object.

q: 我___这本书很无聊，原来故事特别有意思。
zh: 我以为这本书很无聊，原来故事特别有意思。
py: wǒ yǐ wéi zhè běn shū hěn wú liáo yuán lái gù shi tè bié yǒu yì si
en: I thought this book would be boring, but the story turns out to be very interesting.
why: 原来 reveals that the earlier belief was false, so 以为. 认为 states a judgement that is still held and cannot go with 原来.

q: 这种药不___孩子吃，请先问医生。
zh: 这种药不适合孩子吃，请先问医生。
py: zhè zhǒng yào bú shì hé hái zi chī qǐng xiān wèn yī shēng
en: This medicine isn't suitable for children; please ask the doctor first.
why: 孩子 is the object of the blank, which needs the verb 适合. 合适 never takes an object.

q: 这个消息太___了，我还没想好怎么办。
zh: 这个消息太突然了，我还没想好怎么办。
py: zhè ge xiāo xi tài tū rán le wǒ hái méi xiǎng hǎo zěn me bàn
en: This news is so sudden; I haven't decided what to do yet.
why: 太…了 needs an adjective, and 突然 is one. 忽然 is only an adverb and cannot be used as 太忽然了.

q: ___你来北京，一定要给我打电话。
zh: 以后你来北京，一定要给我打电话。
py: yǐ hòu nǐ lái běi jīng yí dìng yào gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà
en: Next time you come to Beijing, be sure to give me a call.
why: The visit is in the future, so 以后. 后来 only moves a past story on to a later stage and can never point to the future.

s: 我们下午去工厂参观，看看面包是怎么做的。
s_py: wǒ men xià wǔ qù gōng chǎng cān guān kàn kan miàn bāo shì zěn me zuò de
zh: 我们下午去工厂参观，看看面包是怎么做的。
py: wǒ men xià wǔ qù gōng chǎng cān guān kàn kan miàn bāo shì zěn me zuò de
en: This afternoon we're visiting the factory to see how bread is made.
why: 参观 is the verb for looking round a place such as a factory, and it can follow 去 + place on its own.

q: 厨房里人手不够，你能来___吗？
zh: 厨房里人手不够，你能来帮忙吗？
py: chú fáng lǐ rén shǒu bú gòu nǐ néng lái bāng máng ma
en: We're short-handed in the kitchen; can you come and help?
why: No person is named, so 帮忙 stands whole. 帮 and 帮助 both need a person right after them.

q: 请你___我一个忙，好吗？
zh: 请你帮我一个忙，好吗？
py: qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ yí ge máng hǎo ma
en: Could you do me a favour?
why: The pattern is 帮 + person + 一个忙. 帮忙 cannot take 我, and 帮助 does not go with 一个忙.

q: 这是一本___中国菜的书，里面有很多图片。
zh: 这是一本关于中国菜的书，里面有很多图片。
py: zhè shì yì běn guān yú zhōng guó cài de shū lǐ miàn yǒu hěn duō tú piàn
en: This is a book about Chinese food, with lots of pictures.
why: 关于 + topic + 的 + noun names what a book is about. 对于 points to a target of an attitude, not a topic.

s: 我很知道这家餐厅的历史。
s_py: wǒ hěn zhī dào zhè jiā cān tīng de lì shǐ
zh: 我很了解这家餐厅的历史。
py: wǒ hěn liǎo jiě zhè jiā cān tīng de lì shǐ
en: I know the history of this restaurant very well.
why: 知道 never takes 很. Knowing something in depth is 了解.

s: 以后有问题，你可以给我打电话。
s_py: yǐ hòu yǒu wèn tí nǐ kě yǐ gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà
zh: 以后有问题，你可以给我打电话。
py: yǐ hòu yǒu wèn tí nǐ kě yǐ gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà
en: From now on, call me if you have a problem.
why: 以后 alone at the start means 'from now on' and looks to the future, so it is correct here.

q: 吃了三碗饭，我___肚子很饱。
zh: 吃了三碗饭，我觉得肚子很饱。
py: chī le sān wǎn fàn wǒ jué de dù zi hěn bǎo
en: After three bowls of rice I feel very full.
why: A body sensation takes 觉得. 认为 is a considered judgement and is never used for feeling full or hungry.

q: 市长下个月要去日本进行正式___。
zh: 市长下个月要去日本进行正式访问。
py: shì zhǎng xià ge yuè yào qù rì běn jìn xíng zhèng shì fǎng wèn
en: The mayor will make an official visit to Japan next month.
why: An official visit to a country is 访问. 看望 is for a person you care about, and 参观 is for looking round a place.

q: 你能___我把这张桌子搬到楼上吗？
zh: 你能帮我把这张桌子搬到楼上吗？
py: nǐ néng bāng wǒ bǎ zhè zhāng zhuō zi bān dào lóu shàng ma
en: Could you help me carry this table upstairs?
why: 帮 + person + verb is everyday help. 帮忙 already contains its object 忙, so 帮忙我 is wrong.

q: 老师___了我很大的忙，我很感谢她。
zh: 老师帮了我很大的忙，我很感谢她。
py: lǎo shī bāng le wǒ hěn dà de máng wǒ hěn gǎn xiè tā
en: The teacher was a great help to me, and I'm very grateful to her.
why: 忙 is already the object, so the pattern is 帮了我很大的忙. 帮忙了我 is wrong because 帮忙 takes no object.

s: 窗户太脏了，我看不懂外面。
s_py: chuāng hu tài zāng le wǒ kàn bu dǒng wài miàn
zh: 窗户太脏了，我看不清楚外面。
py: chuāng hu tài zāng le wǒ kàn bu qīng chu wài miàn
en: The window is so dirty that I can't see outside clearly.
why: A dirty window blocks the view, so the verb is 看不清楚. 看不懂 is about not grasping meaning.

q: 药吃了三天，他昨天晚上___发烧了。
zh: 药吃了三天，他昨天晚上又发烧了。
py: yào chī le sān tiān tā zuó tiān wǎn shang yòu fā shāo le
en: After three days of medicine, he ran a fever again last night.
why: 昨天晚上 is past and 了 closes the event, so a repeat is 又. 再 refers to something that has not happened yet.

s: 她做了十年护士，很有经验。
s_py: tā zuò le shí nián hù shi hěn yǒu jīng yàn
zh: 她做了十年护士，很有经验。
py: tā zuò le shí nián hù shi hěn yǒu jīng yàn
en: She has worked as a nurse for ten years and is very experienced.
why: 有经验 means to have know-how from doing something, which is what ten years of nursing gives.

q: 谢谢你的___，我们很快就做完了。
zh: 谢谢你的帮助，我们很快就做完了。
py: xiè xie nǐ de bāng zhù wǒ men hěn kuài jiù zuò wán le
en: Thank you for your help; we finished very quickly.
why: After 你的 we need the noun 'help', which is 帮助. 帮 is only a verb.

q: 我昨天已经看过这部电影了，今天___看了一遍。
zh: 我昨天已经看过这部电影了，今天又看了一遍。
py: wǒ zuó tiān yǐ jīng kàn guo zhè bù diàn yǐng le jīn tiān yòu kàn le yí biàn
en: I'd already seen this film yesterday, and today I watched it once more.
why: The second viewing is already done (看了), so 又. 再 would put the repeat in the future.

q: 他很___中国电影的历史，常常给我们讲。
zh: 他很了解中国电影的历史，常常给我们讲。
py: tā hěn liǎo jiě zhōng guó diàn yǐng de lì shǐ cháng cháng gěi wǒ men jiǎng
en: He knows the history of Chinese film very well and often tells us about it.
why: 很 plus a topic means knowing it in depth: 了解. 知道 and 认识 cannot be modified by 很.

s: 我认为她不会来，原来她早就到了。
s_py: wǒ rèn wéi tā bú huì lái yuán lái tā zǎo jiù dào le
zh: 我以为她不会来，原来她早就到了。
py: wǒ yǐ wéi tā bú huì lái yuán lái tā zǎo jiù dào le
en: I thought she wouldn't come, but she'd arrived long ago.
why: 原来 reveals the belief was wrong, so it needs 以为. 认为 states a judgement the speaker still holds.

s: 这个决定太忽然了，大家都没想到。
s_py: zhè ge jué dìng tài hū rán le dà jiā dōu méi xiǎng dào
zh: 这个决定太突然了，大家都没想到。
py: zhè ge jué dìng tài tū rán le dà jiā dōu méi xiǎng dào
en: This decision is so sudden that no one expected it.
why: 太…了 needs an adjective. 突然 can be one, but 忽然 is only an adverb.

s: 我发明我的眼镜不见了，到处都找不到。
s_py: wǒ fā míng wǒ de yǎn jìng bú jiàn le dào chù dōu zhǎo bu dào
zh: 我发现我的眼镜不见了，到处都找不到。
py: wǒ fā xiàn wǒ de yǎn jìng bú jiàn le dào chù dōu zhǎo bu dào
en: I noticed my glasses were missing and I can't find them anywhere.
why: Noticing something that is already the case is 发现. 发明 is to invent something new.

s: 明天又是星期一了，真不想上班。
s_py: míng tiān yòu shì xīng qī yī le zhēn bù xiǎng shàng bān
zh: 明天又是星期一了，真不想上班。
py: míng tiān yòu shì xīng qī yī le zhēn bù xiǎng shàng bān
en: It's Monday again tomorrow; I really don't want to go to work.
why: 又 can look ahead to a repeat that is certain to come, especially in the pattern 又是…了.

q: 吃饭___，请先洗手。
zh: 吃饭以前，请先洗手。
py: chī fàn yǐ qián qǐng xiān xǐ shǒu
en: Please wash your hands before eating.
why: 'Before' is clause + 以前. 吃饭的时候 would mean while you are eating, when washing hands makes no sense.

q: 这碗面太好吃了，我想___吃一碗。
zh: 这碗面太好吃了，我想再吃一碗。
py: zhè wǎn miàn tài hǎo chī le wǒ xiǎng zài chī yì wǎn
en: This bowl of noodles is so good that I want another one.
why: The second bowl has not been eaten yet, so 再. 又 only describes a repeat that has already happened.

s: 你认识他住在哪儿吗？
s_py: nǐ rèn shi tā zhù zài nǎ r ma
zh: 你知道他住在哪儿吗？
py: nǐ zhī dào tā zhù zài nǎ r ma
en: Do you know where he lives?
why: 认识 needs a person or character as its object. A question clause such as 住在哪儿 needs 知道.

s: 我以为这本书很难，其实很容易。
s_py: wǒ yǐ wéi zhè běn shū hěn nán qí shí hěn róng yì
zh: 我以为这本书很难，其实很容易。
py: wǒ yǐ wéi zhè běn shū hěn nán qí shí hěn róng yì
en: I thought this book would be hard, but it's actually easy.
why: 其实 shows the first belief was mistaken, which is what 以为 is for.

q: 我很喜欢___，每年都去一个新的城市。
zh: 我很喜欢旅游，每年都去一个新的城市。
py: wǒ hěn xǐ huan lǚ yóu měi nián dōu qù yí ge xīn de chéng shì
en: I love travelling; every year I go to a new city.
why: 旅游 is the activity of travelling for pleasure and can stand alone as the object of 喜欢. 看望 needs a person.

s: 我知道那个导演，可是我不认识他。
s_py: wǒ zhī dào nà ge dǎo yǎn kě shì wǒ bú rèn shi tā
zh: 我知道那个导演，可是我不认识他。
py: wǒ zhī dào nà ge dǎo yǎn kě shì wǒ bú rèn shi tā
en: I know of that director, but I don't know him personally.
why: 知道 means you know who someone is; 认识 means you have met. The two can differ, so the sentence is correct.

s: 你能帮忙我关一下窗户吗？
s_py: nǐ néng bāng máng wǒ guān yí xià chuāng hu ma
zh: 你能帮我关一下窗户吗？
py: nǐ néng bāng wǒ guān yí xià chuāng hu ma
en: Could you close the window for me?
why: 帮忙 is a verb-object and takes no object of its own. Use 帮 + person + verb.

q: 在图书馆看书___，请不要大声说话。
zh: 在图书馆看书时，请不要大声说话。
py: zài tú shū guǎn kàn shū shí qǐng bú yào dà shēng shuō huà
en: Please don't talk loudly when reading in the library.
why: 时 is the short, written form of 'when' and attaches straight to the clause. 以前 and 以后 would move the talking before or after the reading.

q: 经理说得很___，大家都知道该做什么。
zh: 经理说得很清楚，大家都知道该做什么。
py: jīng lǐ shuō de hěn qīng chu dà jiā dōu zhī dào gāi zuò shén me
en: The manager explained it very clearly; everyone knows what to do.
why: How clearly someone speaks is 说得很清楚. 懂 is what the listener does and never describes the speaking.

q: 过年的时候，我们要回老家___爷爷奶奶。
zh: 过年的时候，我们要回老家看望爷爷奶奶。
py: guò nián de shí hou wǒ men yào huí lǎo jiā kàn wàng yé ye nǎi nai
en: At New Year we're going back to our home town to visit grandpa and grandma.
why: Visiting relatives is 看望. 参观 is only for places, so 参观爷爷奶奶 is wrong.

q: 这双鞋很___我，不大也不小。
zh: 这双鞋很适合我，不大也不小。
py: zhè shuāng xié hěn shì hé wǒ bú dà yě bù xiǎo
en: These shoes suit me; they're neither too big nor too small.
why: 我 follows the blank, and only the verb 适合 can take an object. 合适 is an adjective and cannot.

q: 医生把吃药的方法讲得很___，可是奶奶年纪大了，还是没听___。
zh: 医生把吃药的方法讲得很清楚，可是奶奶年纪大了，还是没听懂。
py: yī shēng bǎ chī yào de fāng fǎ jiǎng de hěn qīng chu kě shì nǎi nai nián jì dà le hái shi méi tīng dǒng
en: The doctor explained how to take the medicine very clearly, but grandma is old and still didn't understand.
why: How well someone explains is 讲得很清楚, and 听懂 is the listener making sense of it. 讲得很懂 is never said.

q: 你___这首歌是谁唱的吗？
zh: 你知道这首歌是谁唱的吗？
py: nǐ zhī dào zhè shǒu gē shì shéi chàng de ma
en: Do you know who sings this song?
why: 知道 introduces a question clause (谁唱的). 认识 needs a person or character as object, and 了解 does not introduce a who-clause.

q: 先把菜洗干净，___切成小块，最后放进锅里。
zh: 先把菜洗干净，然后切成小块，最后放进锅里。
py: xiān bǎ cài xǐ gān jìng rán hòu qiē chéng xiǎo kuài zuì hòu fàng jìn guō lǐ
en: First wash the vegetables clean, then cut them into small pieces, and finally put them in the pot.
why: 先…然后…最后 lists steps in order, so 然后. 以后 does not join one step to the next; it follows a clause (洗干净以后) or means 'in future'.

q: 电话是一百多年前一个美国人___的。
zh: 电话是一百多年前一个美国人发明的。
py: diàn huà shì yì bǎi duō nián qián yí ge měi guó rén fā míng de
en: The telephone was invented by an American more than a hundred years ago.
why: A new device is created, so 发明. 发现 is for finding something that already existed.

q: 菜单上的字太小，我看不___。
zh: 菜单上的字太小，我看不清楚。
py: cài dān shàng de zì tài xiǎo wǒ kàn bu qīng chu
en: The writing on the menu is so small that I can't see it clearly.
why: 字太小 is a problem of seeing, so 看不清楚. 看不懂 would mean you can see it but cannot make sense of it.

s: 老师说得很快，每个字我都听清楚了，可是没听懂。
s_py: lǎo shī shuō de hěn kuài měi gè zì wǒ dōu tīng qīng chu le kě shì méi tīng dǒng
zh: 老师说得很快，每个字我都听清楚了，可是没听懂。
py: lǎo shī shuō de hěn kuài měi gè zì wǒ dōu tīng qīng chu le kě shì méi tīng dǒng
en: The teacher spoke fast; I heard every word clearly but didn't understand.
why: 听清楚 is hearing the sounds clearly and 听懂 is grasping the meaning, so they can be told apart in one sentence.

q: 医生___，这种病不用做手术，多休息就可以了。
zh: 医生认为，这种病不用做手术，多休息就可以了。
py: yī shēng rèn wéi zhè zhǒng bìng bú yòng zuò shǒu shù duō xiū xi jiù kě yǐ le
en: The doctor thinks this illness needs no operation; plenty of rest will do.
why: A professional's considered judgement is 认为. 以为 would suggest the doctor was wrong, which nothing in the sentence says.

q: 这本书是用法语写的，我完全看不___。
zh: 这本书是用法语写的，我完全看不懂。
py: zhè běn shū shì yòng fǎ yǔ xiě de wǒ wán quán kàn bu dǒng
en: This book is written in French and I can't understand it at all.
why: A text in a language you do not know is 看不懂. 看不清楚 would be about not seeing the print.

q: ___我来说，在大城市找房子比找工作更难。
zh: 对于我来说，在大城市找房子比找工作更难。
py: duì yú wǒ lái shuō zài dà chéng shì zhǎo fáng zi bǐ zhǎo gōng zuò gèng nán
en: For me, finding a flat in a big city is harder than finding a job.
why: 对于…来说 means 'as far as someone is concerned'. 关于 only introduces a topic and never pairs with 来说.

q: 他在法国住过五年，所以___法语。
zh: 他在法国住过五年，所以懂法语。
py: tā zài fǎ guó zhù guo wǔ nián suǒ yǐ dǒng fǎ yǔ
en: He lived in France for five years, so he knows French.
why: 懂 plus a language means knowing it. 清楚 and 明白 take a matter or a point, not a language.

q: 我和那位医生是老朋友，我们___十年了。
zh: 我和那位医生是老朋友，我们认识十年了。
py: wǒ hé nà wèi yī shēng shì lǎo péng you wǒ men rèn shi shí nián le
en: The doctor and I are old friends; we've known each other for ten years.
why: 认识 plus a length of time says how long two people have been acquainted. 知道 would only mean knowing about them.

s: 离开办公室时，请把灯关掉。
s_py: lí kāi bàn gōng shì shí qǐng bǎ dēng guān diào
zh: 离开办公室时，请把灯关掉。
py: lí kāi bàn gōng shì shí qǐng bǎ dēng guān diào
en: Please turn off the light when you leave the office.
why: 时 attaches directly to the clause, with no 的, in notices and formal speech, so this is correct.

q: 周末我想去医院___一位生病的老同事。
zh: 周末我想去医院看望一位生病的老同事。
py: zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng qù yī yuàn kàn wàng yí wèi shēng bìng de lǎo tóng shì
en: At the weekend I'd like to go to the hospital to visit a sick former colleague.
why: A person you care about is 看望. 参观 is for places you look round, and 访问 is an official visit.

q: 雨___没停，我们在咖啡馆多坐一会儿吧。
zh: 雨还没停，我们在咖啡馆多坐一会儿吧。
py: yǔ hái méi tíng wǒ men zài kā fēi guǎn duō zuò yí huì r ba
en: The rain hasn't stopped yet; let's stay a bit longer in the café.
why: 还没 means 'not yet', a situation that continues. 又 and 再 describe repeats, and neither fits 没停 here.

q: 新同事刚来，什么都不熟悉，经理让我多___他。
zh: 新同事刚来，什么都不熟悉，经理让我多帮助他。
py: xīn tóng shì gāng lái shén me dōu bù shú xī jīng lǐ ràng wǒ duō bāng zhù tā
en: The new colleague has just arrived and isn't familiar with anything, so the manager asked me to help him more.
why: 帮助 takes a person as object: 多帮助他. 帮忙 contains its own object and cannot be followed by 他.
